input_boundaries: Supplied true-column and Forms0/rational-forms packages, including their all-place lattice characterization and emb_basis/Fi_zero dimension bridge.
ValEx (CmpCore.ex) remains a substantive supplied polynomial-value condition; exact suppliers are recorded in next_targets.json.
Joint0 and LevelZeroCharacterRational retain their global supplier status. SameUloc is Joint0.Uloc_eq once Joint0 is supplied.
GatIs supplies the actual local models; CR6 supplies their rank equality.
No metric/isometric transport, theta kernel, cohomological window or prime-window theorem is claimed.
precision_notes: HtupW uses integral Weyl Delta, not naive Htup/Nabla; no equality of those lattices is asserted.
Odd local weight is lambda* and its coordinate matrix is inverse transpose; LI conjugation parity changes this to inverse conjugate transpose.
Valuation descent uses finite support and a valuation pivot, not a finite coefficient extension.
The L-linear retraction K -> L need not preserve O; integrality follows separately from the exact localized-lattice criterion.
CR6 matches rank_O M to dim_C Mu0; emb_basis and Fi_zero provide the additional global L-dimension equality.
Local rational spanning includes stabilizer invariants through saturation, with no division by stabilizer order.
The final equality is integral, with no discarded finite index.
